title: Quick Hits
summary: **Govt approves polymer ₹10/₹20 notes** — RBI first proposed 2009; 2012 pilot in 5 cities (Kochi, Mysuru, Jaipur, Bhubaneswar, Shimla).

items: **Govt approves polymer ₹10/₹20 notes** — RBI first proposed 2009; 2012 pilot in 5 cities (Kochi, Mysuru, Jaipur, Bhubaneswar, Shimla).

**Paytm Payments Bank wound up** — licence cancelled under Sec 22(4), Banking Regulation Act; liquidator Girikumar Nair (ex-SBI CGM). Payments Banks total = 5 (Airtel first 2017; IPPB first govt-owned).
**RBI bulk deposit rate norms:** implementation deadline pushed to 1 Oct 2026; deposits <₹3cr exempted.
**RBI Basel Pillar 3 disclosure framework:** 10 amendment directions for banks.
**Bloomberg's IGB e-trading platform:** connects to NDS-OM (RBI, 2005); T+1 settlement, CCIL-guaranteed.
**IFSCA DEAF Scheme 2026 (draft):** unclaimed-deposit fund for GIFT IFSC banking units, mirrors RBI's DEAF (Sec 26A, Banking Regulation Act — 10-yr unclaimed transfer rule).
**RBI draft: mandatory demat for securitisation notes** — min ₹1 crore ticket size; effective 1 Oct 2026.
**RBI's simpler FDI compliance regime (draft):** principle-based framework per Budget 2026-27 announcement.
